1.why: The text across all screens uses a clean, legible sans-serif typeface with generous line and letter spacing.

2.why: Instructions are presented in concise sentences without any italics, all-caps text, or dense text blocks.

3.why: The application is displayed in a fixed-width desktop card layout with wide side margins rather than a native mobile viewport format.

4.why: Instructional text throughout the flow is brief, clear, and written in plain language.

5.why: The six-digit authenticator code input box does not display an example or placeholder format.

6.why: No step presents long blocks of text required for the user to read.

7.why: The long setup secret key is shown as plain text without any copy-to-clipboard button provided.

8.why: The app explicitly requires manual key entry and provides no QR code image as an alternative.

9.why: Standard form fields are used, but no explicit password manager or browser autofill indicators are visible.

10.why: Primary action buttons are prominent dark blue elements that clearly stand out on every screen.

11.why: Each screen asks the user to take only one main action before proceeding.

12.why: The screens and log status panel clearly report completed actions and transition to the next step.

13.why: Users can retry entering codes upon error without penalty, but options to reveal, hide, or re-request setup codes are missing.

14.why: The error message 'We could not complete that request. Please try again.' does not explain the specific problem or how to fix it.

15.why: There are no visible countdown timers or strict time limits shown anywhere in the interface.
